name: Symbiosis
source:
The previously monotonous work of supervising Mars’s colonization preparations quickly fills with challenges. The protagonist has to confront these obstacles and their origins to decide the destiny of the mission and the planet.

[From [url=https://nyarstot.itch.io/symbiosis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
此前监督火星殖民准备工作的单调工作很快就充满了挑战。主角必须面对这些障碍及其起源，以决定任务和地球的命运。

[来自[url=https://nyarstot.itch.io/symbiosis]Itch.io[/url]]
